A human hand enters the frame from the right and rhythmically pats the cat's lower back. (2) The cat walks through a doorway into a wider living space with white cabinets and a staircase. It pauses and squats briefly on the floor while the camera follows its movement. (3) A close-up shot shows the cat's face as it looks toward the camera with wide green eyes. It then walks up onto a low wooden platform or step. (4) The cat is now in a room specifically designed for pets, featuring various wooden cat furniture and scratchers. It sits on the floor, and the hand appears again to pat its rear repeatedly. (5) The cat moves to a child's bedroom with a bunk bed and a colorful geometric rug featuring red, green, and blue triangles. It lies down on the mat and receives more pats. (6) Finally, the cat is perched on a white windowsill in front of a large window looking out onto greenery. It stretches its body and opens its mouth in a yawn-like expression while the hand continues to pat its back.
